Now that I have the orders, I need to check the reported refunds against the ledger to ensure they match. I will use the list_refunds tool to get the actual recorded refunds.

I have confirmed the refunds. The reported refunds from Alpha Co were: [{'order_id': 410, 'amount_cents': 1071}, {'order_id': 411, 'amount_cents': 23814}, {'order_id': 415, 'amount_cents': 1707}]. The actual refunds recorded are: [{'order_id': 410, 'amount_cents': 1071}, {'order_id': 415, 'amount_cents': 1707}].
